en: A bottle opener is a second-class lever because the bottle cap acts as the load positioned between the fulcrum and your hand.
Geckos climb smooth glass using millions of microscopic hairs on their feet that create molecular friction with the surface.
The Moon's gravitational pull is only one-sixth of Earth's, meaning a 60-pound child would weigh just 10 pounds there.
If you cut a permanent bar magnet in half, you get two smaller complete magnets rather than isolated north and south poles.
A single bolt of lightning contains enough electrical energy to toast approximately 100,000 slices of bread.
Sunlight takes about eight minutes and twenty seconds to travel the 150 million kilometers from the Sun to Earth.
Sound travels roughly four times faster in water than in air because liquid molecules are packed much closer together.
The hottest part of a standard candle flame is the invisible blue base at the bottom, not the bright yellow top.
A stretched rubber band stores elastic potential energy that instantly transforms into kinetic energy when you let it go.
The kinetic energy of a moving object quadruples when its speed doubles, making high-speed car crashes much more destructive.
Ocean waves transfer energy across thousands of miles without actually transporting the water molecules themselves forward over that distance.
Thermos flasks keep drinks hot by using a vacuum layer between two walls to completely prevent heat transfer by conduction.
